style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Coherent warm yellow fitted side armor with softly rounded layered forms, readable metal/cream accents, real finite seating on the frozen body and subtle clean native active motion.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A coherent pair of fitted yellow side-armor saddles with softly rounded substantial edges and useful layered construction. The pair reads clearly on its own and as armor on the frozen Sub; keep the central periscope corridor open.
visibleChecks: All4 standalone idle views show crafted thickness and a clear paired design, without a weak blank side or confusing disconnected hardware.
All4 mounted neutral views show seated armor without a hovering underside, central bridge, body/periscope intersection or hidden forced fit.
Treat original six-part count, thick center block and continuous target center strip as observations rather than locks.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Warm yellow/orange armor, a restrained creamy/light-yellow raised accent and purposeful metal fasteners have distinguishable volumes/materials with broad gentle highlights.
visibleChecks: At logical size, broad yellow masses retain roundness rather than clipping into flat white/yellow fields.
Warm edge separation and cool/neutral hardware remain clear without thick dark outlines, black undersides or muddy grooves.

No preferred horizontal key direction across rotatable world views, no directional ground shadow, no copied ImageGen halos. Exact approved materials must work unchanged under own55degree and frozen-main65degree cameras/light rigs.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A subtle one-second native breathing/lift gesture remains readable and closes cleanly while keeping the armor assembled and above the ground.
